display_long_description:
“The Cabin offers some of the most enjoyable and intense short-session action currently available on the Quest “ - 6DOF 

Locked in a creepy cabin deep in the woods, you must rely on your wits, your reflexes and your firepower to survive. Scavenge for supplies, arm yourself to the teeth and fend off relentless waves of grotesque proto-zombie creatures clawing at every entrance.

[media]

**✔ Play Solo or Up to 4-Player Co-Op**

Play solo or squad up with up to three friends in full 4-player co-op. Revive each other, cover every door and turn total chaos into coordinated carnage.

[media]

**✔ Endless Hordes**

Can you handle the intense action of 15+ zombies on screen at any given time? Stay alert and use every tool at your disposal to survive.

[media]

**✔ Scavenge for Resources**

Search high and low for ammo, weapons and anything that gives you an edge. Every bullet counts. Run dry and you’re done.

**✔ Gear up**

Customize your loadout with a wide range of firearms, melee weapons, and other tools to suit your playstyle.

**✔ Power Up**

Level up your character and unlock powerful perks and weapon upgrades that turn desperate last stands into explosive victories.

**✔ Unlock New Areas**

Push beyond the cabin into new zones crawling with fresh horrors and new survival challenges.

**✔ Climb the Leaderboards**

Climb the leaderboards and show off your skills to the world.

**✔ Home Invasion**

Turn your real-world space into a creepy Cabin with the FREE Home Invasion MR game mode.

[media]

Do you have what it takes to survive The Cabin? 

**Discord: Soulassembly.com/cabin**
